prompts.prompt: Create one exceptionally detailed speculative architectural drawing, horizontal 3:2. This is an architectural design study for temporary young collective housing, Ribera de Curtidores 31 Madrid. Image 1 is the authoritative geometric base from actual cadastral site and actual municipal 3D surroundings. Keep the exact camera, narrow tapering plot, position, size and silhouette of ALL surrounding buildings, and proposed massing INSIDE its red perimeter. Zoom modestly to make proposal dominant while leaving identifiable adjacent buildings. Do not invent an isolated building or new landscape. Images 2 and 3 are ONLY visual language references from user's actual Pinterest: intricate line hierarchies, precise mechanical drawing, layered analytical overlays, palpable collage texture, graphite soot, selective oxblood red, translucent tracing, hatching and construction seams. Absorb visual language without reproducing their buildings or text. The new architecture must be raw, radical, socially transformative and spatially legible. Show load paths, structure, occupied room depths, shared infrastructure and thresholds. A dense but readable architectural cutaway, with tiny few unsentimental everyday human silhouettes. No generic green cohousing, no picturesque courtyard balconies, no happy advertising, no lush planting, no random pipes as decoration, no flags or slogans as substitute for mechanisms. No brand, no top banner, no huge heading. Tiny Spanish words only where specified, otherwise numbered callouts. Draw the surrounding city in faded charcoal but preserve its geometry. This is an interpretive elaboration, not a permit drawing. MECHANISM A: four transverse inhabited ribs connected by a thick permanent service edge on the blind southern party-wall. Interpret the four horizontal levels as 4.8m high spaces that alternate lower private rooms and tall shared repair/dining rooms, not identical flats. Sky slots between ribs remain open all the way to ground and bring visible light to shared circulation. Make steel Vierendeel frames and accessible service panels explicit, metal mesh, rough lime, reclaimed plywood, corrugated sheet in patches. Show a 3-state small inset detail of a thick storage partition rotating 90 degrees: two private study booths / joined shared worktable / closed acoustic room. On main axon show where this detail occurs. Labels 'COSTILLAS', 'VACÍO', 'SERVICIO COMÚN'. No giant crane.

Produce ONE original high-detail architectural mechanism drawing for the young collective housing project Ribera de Curtidores 31, Madrid. Horizontal 3:2. Use the supplied actual Pinterest references as visual direction: obsessive fine technical linework, diagrammatic overlays, material collage, sharp dark cut masses, translucent analytical ghost states, mechanically articulated components, tension cables with real function, scuffed plywood, mesh, graphite, photographic fabric and concrete grain. NO generic watercolor, NO branding or slogan header, NO corporate infographic cards, NO happy lifestyle scene, NO decorative pipes, NO suburban landscape. Small Spanish labels only. This is radical domestic architecture through redistribution of space, control, labour and resources; draw physical changes, not left-wing symbols. Be experimental and compositionally intense. A tactile forensic axonometric study of one thick communal 'hinge room' situated between FOUR permanent private rooms, not four apartments on a corridor. Private doors stay independently lockable and beds never move. The shared central room is 6x5m. Three massive acoustic bookcase-partitions rotate on engineered floor/ceiling pivots (arcs drawn) while a fourth slides into a fixed pocket. Show three overlapping ghost states: two independent quiet study rooms; one large making table; a temporary care room entered without passing another bedroom. Main view exploded from above with 1:10 pivot section, bearing, safety stop, seals and wheel track. Assembly is a real chunky material object, blackened steel red bearings plywood compressed textile, no slick finish. Include one person moving a light unloaded panel and one person inside quiet closed room. Labels 'CERRAR', 'NEGOCIAR', 'ABRIR' and small 'La cama no rota. El común cambia.' The composition is one intricate object, not a cute triptych.
